name: Election
description: A population of voters with distinct personalities reads through a list of candidates (each with a name and description) and casts a single vote — with a reason. No campaigning, no rounds, just judgement.

phases.name: voting
phases.description: Each voter reads the candidate list and casts one vote.

entity_types.name: Candidate
entity_types.description: A candidate on the ballot — passive entity that voters read and vote for. Has a name and a description (platform, background, anything voters would know).

properties.name: description
properties.description: Free-text description: platform, background, positions, biography — anything a voter would consider.

entity_types.name: Voter
entity_types.description: A voter who reads the candidate list and casts one vote based on their personality, values, and the candidate descriptions.

properties.name: has_voted
properties.description: Whether this voter has already cast their vote. Once true, the vote action becomes unavailable — the engine then skips this voter on subsequent rounds (no LLM calls).

actions.name: vote
actions.description: Cast your vote for one candidate. Pick the candidate whose name + description best fits your values, then briefly explain why.

parameters.name: candidate
parameters.description: The entity_id of the candidate you are voting for. Must match one of the candidates visible in your perception.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: One or two sentences explaining why you picked this candidate over the others.

effects_on_success.description: Mark this voter as having voted so they won't be asked again.
Increment the chosen candidate's vote tally.

properties.description: Progressive platform — universal healthcare, climate action, tax reform on the wealthy. Three-term legislator. Career civic background.
Conservative platform — fiscal discipline, deregulation, traditional values, border security. Former executive. Outsider framing.

agent_archetypes.name: Strong Partisan
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Fiercely loyal partisan voter with deep ideological conviction. Votes based on tribal loyalty and resists candidates from the other side regardless of merit.

agent_archetypes.name: Moderate Swing Voter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Centrist voter who weighs both sides carefully. Reads candidate descriptions critically and picks based on character, competence, and concrete positions rather than ideology.

agent_archetypes.name: Issue Voter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Single-issue voter who cares deeply about one specific policy area and judges candidates almost entirely on their stated stance on that issue.

agent_archetypes.name: Apathetic Voter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Disengaged voter who skims candidate descriptions quickly and picks based on gut feeling, vibe, name recognition, or first impression.

agent_archetypes.name: Informed Independent
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Well-informed independent thinker who reads candidate descriptions carefully, weighs evidence over rhetoric, and resists tribal loyalty.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Voters
runtime_parameters.description: How many voters cast a ballot in this election.

runtime_parameters.name: election_type
runtime_parameters.label: Election Type
runtime_parameters.description: What kind of election — political (presidential, mayoral, referendum), organizational (CEO, board director, HOA president, club chair), or anything else. Free text.

runtime_parameters.name: election_context
runtime_parameters.label: Election Context
runtime_parameters.description: Short framing for the election — what's at stake, the setting, any background voters would know. Optional.

termination_conditions.description: All voters get one round to vote; round 2 is a safety net for any failed attempts.
